Rank = sum of the two percentile ranks, percentile = share of the 243 strictly below. 19 of the top 20 are cta_type=comment_keyword. The two-rate framing is I-12's own reading of our selection ('M2's reference selection ranks by share and save per 1 000') and 01-general-conclusions.md section H item 4.

strategy.audience: Non-technical small-business leader, AI level 0-6 of 10 (POSITIONING.md §4): an owner, operations lead or team lead in a 5-50 person company who is responsible for one repeated process and has tried ChatGPT but has no repeatable way of using it at work. Specifically anyone who works from a queue somebody else sorted: enquiries, tickets, applications, invoices.
strategy.concept: We re-sorted our own weekly priority list after making the comparison fair, and nineteen of the top twenty items turned out to be there on a habit that has nothing to do with quality.

filter.ai_boundary: The machine ranks and has to show, per item, which field put it where. A named human owns the definition of 'important', re-reads it against a handful of items by hand, and is the only one who may change the weighting.
filter.friction: The sort order comes out of a formula nobody re-reads, so over time the queue quietly optimises for whatever the formula happens to count rather than for what actually matters, and the drift is invisible because the list still looks sorted.
filter.next_action: Take the five items your system put at the top this week and find what they have in common that has nothing to do with importance.
filter.process: Deciding what to look at first in a recurring queue of incoming work - which enquiry gets answered, which ticket gets picked up, which invoice gets chased - where the order is produced by a rule or a score rather than by reading every item.

strategy.objective: Hand the viewer one check they can run on their own priority list this week, using our own ranking being wrong as the demonstration.
strategy.promise: One check that tells you whether your priority list is measuring importance or measuring a habit.
strategy.rationale: The references supply the shape only: a result-first opening on the artefact (DZLDk9ySi-7), one short mid-roll re-hook before the evidence (DNA7-d3o5sQ), a fixed consequence-then-fix cadence (DbO4zvJR1k8), per-item contribution shown on screen rather than a summary (DX9kWTYzssE), and an ungated close that names a bounded test (DTCOU9DkRTG). Nothing in the 266-reel analysed corpus shows an author's own system producing a wrong answer, so the subject is ours alone.

title: Nineteen of our top twenty were there on a trick

traceability.evidence_summary: Our own weekly selection script ranks candidates by shares and saves per thousand views. In the analysed corpus the comment-keyword prompt multiplies the median save rate 2.8-fold and the median share rate 1.8-fold while moving reach not at all (view_lift p=0.578, robust_z p=0.63), and 143 of the 243 candidates that carry both rates and a labelled ask use it. Ranked the way the script ranks, nineteen of the top twenty carry the prompt; re-ranked within the same ask, eight ungated posts appear in the top twenty and two travel from 67th and 61st to 8th and 9th. The five references contribute structure only: an artefact-first opening (DZLDk9ySi-7, 51.4x on a 3 421-view author median), one 1.8-second mid-roll re-hook (DNA7-d3o5sQ, ungated, 36.5 saves/1k), a fixed consequence-then-fix cadence (DbO4zvJR1k8, 87.4 saves/1k), per-item contribution on screen (DX9kWTYzssE, ungated, 41.3 shares/1k) and an ungated bounded-test close (DTCOU9DkRTG, 29.7 shares/1k).
traceability.original_synthesis: The failure, the re-ranking and both rank movements are ours, computed from our own database on 2026-09-12 and reproducible from video_features. No reel in the 266-reel analysed corpus shows an author's own system producing a wrong answer; before_after is the second-rarest proof type at n=5 and not one reel anywhere shows the author's build breaking. The generalisation - that every sorted queue is optimising whatever it happens to count - is stated as a parallel and listed in claims as MISSING rather than as evidence.
traceability.why_better_than_generic: A generic AI script would say 'don't blindly trust AI rankings' and stop. This one names the exact field that broke the sort, the exact multipliers it inflates (2.8 and 1.8), the exact thing it does not touch (reach), the exact fix (compare within the same ask) and the exact movement that fix produced (67th and 61st to 8th and 9th) - and it shows the movement on screen, which is the only visual feature in the corpus that survives creator normalisation on two independent metrics.
